title: Build a streaming MedianFinder in Rust using two heaps
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement MedianFinder that maintains a running median as numbers are added. Use a max-heap (lower half) and a min-heap (upper half) to achieve O(log n) add and O(1) find_median.

required_artifacts: lower is BinaryHeap<i32> (max-heap); upper is BinaryHeap<Reverse<i32>> (min-heap)
add_num maintains invariant: lower.len() == upper.len() or lower.len() == upper.len() + 1
find_median returns lower.peek() for odd count, average of both tops for even count
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
